name: CAVE
description: CAVE is the first benchmark of real-world commonsense anomalies in visual environments. It supports three open-ended tasks: anomaly description, explanation, and justification, with fine-grained annotations on anomaly types, complexity, severity, and commonness, aimed at evaluating vision-language models.
reputation: A new but notable benchmark from a recent paper; it has early interest in vision-language and commonsense reasoning research but is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Focuses on real-world visual commonsense anomaly detection and explanation with cognitively grounded annotations.
